scope: Two guarded full Gemma 4 26B-A4B native Artisan/Metal generation probes on M5 Pro 24 GiB. No throughput or quality benchmark.

worker_result.prompt: Reply with only the word OK.
In one short sentence, explain what RAM stores.

limitations: The successful response is one OK text response under output budget 1; this does not establish sustained multi-token generation.
Second run changed both prompt and output budget, so it cannot isolate either effect.
Other applications, memory pressure, file residency and cache state are not controlled.
Engine/conversation creation and entry into send_message are host-side phases, not proof of GPU upload or prefill completion.
Blocking send_message does not expose partial token progress on interrupted runs.
Total worker duration includes creation, generation and cleanup; do not label it TTFT or decode time.
